title: Atlas playbook answer map
description: Translates the workflow's dropdowns into the option names the Atlas playbook declares in playbook.conf. The playbook asks its questions with RadioPage / CheckboxPage elements; each one is answered here, and scripts/atlas-playbook.ps1 fails the build if the playbook renames an option rather than quietly applying the wrong branch.

fixedOptions.disable-power-saving: Already applied by the Core-Gaming first-boot power pass (config/gaming_power_settings.json installs the Atlas Power Scheme). Atlas asks this as a checkbox; here it is always on.
fixedOptions.disable-core-isolation: Already applied by the gaming profile, which turns VBS / HVCI / Credential Guard off. Exposing it again would only offer a switch that does nothing.
fixedOptions.install-toolbox: Atlas Toolbox is handled by a dedicated path: the official AtlasToolbox-Setup.exe is fetched, staged into the image and run once by SetupComplete.cmd before the first logon. The playbook's own step downloads and installs it on a live system, which cannot happen against a mounted image.

notApplicable.install-another-browser: Installs Brave / Firefox / LibreWolf / Chrome from the internet. An offline image cannot install software, and the browser question is only reachable when this one is ticked.
notApplicable.browser-brave: Requires install-another-browser, which needs a live OS with internet.
notApplicable.browser-librewolf: Requires install-another-browser, which needs a live OS with internet.
notApplicable.browser-firefox: Requires install-another-browser, which needs a live OS with internet.
notApplicable.browser-chrome: Requires install-another-browser, which needs a live OS with internet.
